title: Lone Star Ruby Conference 2010 Real Software Engineering by Glenn Vanderburg
summary: Glenn Vanderburg argues at Lone Star Ruby Conference 2010 that university-style software engineering does not work, and asks what real software engineering would look like. He revisits the waterfall model and what engineering means in other fields.
why: HN recommends it for changing minds about whether programmers can be called engineers, and for its take on how waterfall was misread.

quote.text: I always thought calling programmers engineers was very weird until I watched this great talk
